function setProofBox(page,label,value,image){var box=proofLine(page,label);if(!box)return;var line=box.querySelector('.rc390-line');if(!line)return;var signatureField=low(label).indexOf('unterschrift')>=0;box.classList.toggle('index352-signature-box',signatureField&&!!image);line.innerHTML='';if(image){var img=page.ownerDocument.createElement('img');img.className='index352-proof-signature';img.alt='Fahrerunterschrift';img.setAttribute('crossorigin','use-credentials');img.addEventListener('error',function(){box.classList.remove('index352-signature-box');line.innerHTML=''});img.src=image;line.appendChild(img)}else line.textContent=q(value)}
